title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.22727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the conditional distribution of limit-order volume submitted over the next five minutes, given the current order book and recent order flow. The task requires capturing price placement, total volume, and predictive uncertainty jointly. Coordinate-wise diffusion losses do not explicitly account for price displacement, while normalizing fields to unit mass removes information about total volume. Agreement on selected summary statistics also does not establish fidelity to the joint field distribution. We introduce OrderFlowDiT, a conditional Diffusion Transformer for unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields, trained with an unbalanced optimal-transport (UOT) auxiliary loss. We also develop a full-field evaluation framework that combines a transport cost sensitive to price placement and total volume with proper scoring rules and calibration diagnostics. In the primary comparison on 1950 validation conditions across 30 U.S.

translated_title: OrderFlowDiT：用于概率性限价订单供给预测的传输正则化扩散Transformer
translated_abstract: 我们研究在给定当前订单簿和近期订单流的条件下，未来五分钟内提交的限价订单量的条件分布。该任务需要联合捕捉价格放置位置、总量以及预测不确定性。逐坐标的扩散损失没有明确考虑价格位移，而将场归一化为单位质量则会移除关于总量的信息。在选定的汇总统计量上的一致性也不能保证对联合场分布的忠实还原。我们提出OrderFlowDiT，这是一个针对未归一化的买卖双方价格-成交量场的条件扩散Transformer，采用非平衡最优传输（UOT）辅助损失进行训练。我们还开发了一个全场评估框架，该框架将对手的价格放置位置和总量敏感的传输成本与适当的评分规则和校准诊断相结合。在针对30只美国（股票）的1950个验证条件的主要比较中……
tldr: 该论文提出OrderFlowDiT，一个结合非平衡最优传输辅助损失的条件扩散Transformer，能够对未归一化的价格-成交量场进行建模，联合预测未来五分钟限价订单的价格放置位置、总量和预测不确定性，并配套开发了全场评估框架。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces OrderFlowDiT, a conditional Diffusion Transformer trained with an unbalanced optimal-transport auxiliary loss that forecasts the full conditional distribution of limit-order volume over the next five minutes, jointly capturing price placement, total volume, and predictive uncertainty, along with a full-field evaluation framework.
